title: ethers(5) — Ethernet host name database

date.notes: OpenBSD manual revision preserving historical provenance

claims_extracted.claim: The ethers file maps Ethernet addresses to host names; the format was adopted from SunOS and appeared in NetBSD 0.9b, with historical YP integration through a '+' line.
claims_extracted.notes: Some NetBSD manual branches cite NetBSD 1.0 rather than 0.9b; preserve exact manual lineage rather than flattening.

conflicts: NetBSD/OpenBSD descendant manuals differ on whether first NetBSD appearance is 0.9b or 1.0.
notes: SunOS original source/manual remains a priority source.
